MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hard drive enclosure fits my interest in practical computer connections, though I would skip it without a drive that needs an enclosure.",
    "The HDMI cable relates to my earlier DVI cable purchase because both connect displays, but I would need the right ports and a reason for that length."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "My earlier headset does not mean I need a dedicated TV listening system or fitness earbuds; those serve different purposes.",
    "A small-tablet mount does not imply a TV mounting project, and my network adapters do not suggest an amateur radio hobby.",
    "The cooling pad, smart speaker and SD card address needs I have not expressed. I would not choose them simply because they are electronics."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having bought a headset seems to have been treated as an ongoing interest in different kinds of audio equipment.",
    "Connections such as wireless capability or mounting hardware seem to matter too much when the devices and intended uses are quite different."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, which points more directly toward practical computer connectivity than entertainment devices.",
    "My purchases are spread over years. I rarely interact, and a related accessory only interests me when it solves a specific current problem.",
    "Compatibility matters: a cable needs the right connectors and length, and an enclosure needs to fit a drive I actually have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in computer accessories but stretched isolated purchases into needs I have not shown."
}
